# ApiLens

NuvyntraLabs.NET.ApiLens — developer diagnostics for ASP.NET Core (MVC and minimal APIs).

- Core: NuvyntraLabs.NET.ApiLens
- Host: NuvyntraLabs.NET.ApiLens.AspNetCore (`AddApiLens`, `UseApiLens`, `/_apilens` in Development only)
- EF Core: NuvyntraLabs.NET.ApiLens.EntityFrameworkCore
- HTTP: NuvyntraLabs.NET.ApiLens.Http
- Dashboard page: NuvyntraLabs.NET.ApiLens.UI

Not endjin/ApiLens (XML doc search). Not an OpenTelemetry exporter. Parameter values and request bodies are never stored.
